proposal.reason: Main change removes CollNet execution from runtime networking, including CollNet plugin loading/symbol handling and proxy-path usage (network). Additional substantive changes delete CollNet transport setup/connect/free paths and transport table wiring (transport), remove CollNet device collective kernel implementations while keeping algorithm slot 2 reserved/null for ABI stability (kernels), drop CollNet logical graph construction/connection behavior (graph-search), remove CollNet-specific NIC/topology capability ingestion in topology discovery structures (device-topology), disable CollNet in cost/tuning selection while preserving external tuner v1 ID layout and fallback semantics (tuning), and update collective planning/algorithm-pattern/channel scheduling so CollNet can no longer be selected or dispatched (enqueue).
